summary: The demo notes page is now a static file read once at app creation. It has one centered card of at most 40rem, a spacing scale and every colour as CSS variables, light and dark themes, an inline SVG logo, a labelled input with a live n/200 counter, an Add button disabled while the text is blank, note cards with a fade-in that respects reduced motion, an empty state and an alert on a failed save that keeps the typed text. The page is about 5 KB with no external resource. Unit tests check its structure and the end to end tests check the behaviour in a browser.
